enriched_activities.activity: Working a night shift at the aged care residence: monitoring residents, assisting with personal care and mobility, and completing written handover notes.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along the corridor of the aged care residence. Push the medication trolley to the first room. Open the door. Turn on the room light. Greet the resident. Check the resident's position in bed. Place a hand on the resident's shoulder. Help the resident turn onto their side. Adjust the pillow under the resident's head. Pull the blanket up to the resident's chest. Turn off the room light. Close the door. Walk to the next room. Repeat the check. Return to the nurse's station. Sit at the desk. Pick up the pen. Write the observation time in the handover book. Record the resident's mobility and food intake. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom with a resident. Hold the resident's arm. Guide the resident onto the toilet. Wait outside the door. Assist the resident back to bed. Push the trolley to the kitchenette. Fill a cup with water. Carry the cup to a resident. Hand the cup to the resident. Collect the empty cup. Walk back to the nurse's station. Pick up the handover folder. Read the previous shift notes. Write the handover notes for the next shift. Sign the bottom of the page. Stand up. Hand the folder to the incoming staff member. Say: 'Handover is done, bed three needs a check at six.' Clock out at the staff terminal.

enriched_activities.activity: Travelling home by train and bus after night shift handover, following the route between the care facility and Clayton.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the care facility front door. Walk to the bus stop. Stand at the bus stop. Open the bag. Take out the Myki card. Hold the card in hand. Board the bus. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Sit on a seat. Place the bag on the lap. Look at the phone. Check the time. Stand up when the stop is announced. Tap the Myki card on the reader. Step off the bus. Walk to the train station entrance. Walk up the stairs to the platform. Stand on the platform. Board the train. Sit near the door. Place the bag on the floor. Rest the head against the window. Take out the phone. Open the reminder list. Read the list. Put the phone back in the pocket. Stand up at Clayton station. Step off the train. Walk down the stairs. Exit the station. Walk along the footpath to the house. Open the front gate. Walk up the driveway. Unlock the front door with the key. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a light flexitarian breakfast and a pot of tea, eating quietly before resting.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the milk. Take out the bread. Close the refrigerator door. Place the bread on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a plate. Close the cupboard door. Put two slices of bread on the plate. Open the cutlery drawer. Take out a knife. Close the drawer. Spread spread on the bread with the knife. Put the knife in the sink. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Open the cupboard door. Take out a teabag. Close the cupboard door. Drop the teabag into a mug. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Carry the plate and the mug to the table. Sit on the chair. Eat the bread. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the plate and mug to the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the dish rack. Turn off the kitchen light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and washing up to wind down after the night shift.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the shower screen. Turn the shower tap to warm. Step into the shower. Wet the body under the water. Pick up the soap. Lather the body. Rinse the body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Put the bottle down. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower screen. Step out of the shower. Take the towel off the hook. Dry the hair with the towel. Dry the body with the towel. Hang the towel back on the hook. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth with water from the tap. Turn off the tap. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping after the night shift with the fan running for white noise and the curtains drawn to keep the room dark and quiet.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Close the bedroom door. Pull the curtains closed across the window. Turn on the bedroom light. Change out of the work clothes. Put the work clothes into the laundry basket. Put on the sleepwear. Turn on the fan. Press the fan speed button. Turn off the bedroom light. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Close the eyes. Sleep. Turn onto the side during sleep. Sleep. Turn onto the back during sleep. Sleep. Open the eyes. Lie still on the bed. Rub the eyes with the hand. Sit up on the edge of the bed. Press the fan off button. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking slowly, checking phone reminders, and writing a short written plan for the rest of the day.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on the edge of the bed. Place both feet on the floor. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Sit on the desk chair. Pick up the phone from the desk. Press the phone button. Unlock the phone. Open the reminders app. Scroll through the reminder list. Read each reminder. Tap one reminder. Put the phone down on the desk. Open the desk drawer. Take out a notepad. Close the drawer. Pick up a pen from the pen holder. Write the date at the top of the page. Write 'study' on the first line. Write 'placement notes' on the second line. Write 'budget' on the third line. Write 'laundry' on the fourth line. Put the pen down. Tear off no page. Close the notepad. Place the notepad on the desk. Pick up the phone again. Check the time. Put the phone down. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and dressing for the afternoon.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Open the shower screen. Turn on the shower tap. Step into the shower. Wet the hair and body. Pick up the shampoo bottle. Open the cap. Pour shampoo into the palm. Close the cap. Rub the shampoo into the hair. Rinse the hair. Pick up the soap. Lather the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower tap. Open the shower screen. Step out. Take the towel off the hook. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Hang the towel on the hook. Walk out of the bathroom to Bedroom 1. Open the wardrobe door. Take out a shirt. Take out trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Put on the shirt. Put on the trousers. Walk back to the bathroom. Stand in front of the mirror. Pick up the comb. Comb the hair. Put the comb down. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating a simple flexitarian lunch with tea, then wiping down the counter.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the container of cooked vegetables. Take out the eggs. Close the refrigerator door. Place the container on the counter. Open the cupboard door. Take out a bowl. Close the cupboard door. Open the container lid. Spoon the vegetables into the bowl. Close the container lid. Put the container back in the refrigerator. Crack two eggs into a pan. Turn on the induction cooker. Stir the eggs with a spatula. Turn off the induction cooker. Slide the eggs onto the bowl. Fill the kettle with water. Press the kettle switch. Take a teabag from the cupboard. Drop the teabag into a mug. Pour the water into the mug. Carry the bowl and mug to the table. Sit on the chair. Eat the food with a fork. Drink the tea. Stand up. Carry the bowl and mug to the sink. Rinse the bowl. Rinse the fork. Place the bowl and fork in the dish rack. Take the cloth from the hook. Wipe the counter with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Hang the cloth back on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the local neighbourhood for fresh air and light exercise, without spending money.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the front door. Put on the shoes. Tie the shoelaces. Open the front door. Step outside. Close the front door. Walk down the driveway. Turn right onto the footpath. Walk along the footpath. Pass the neighbour's fence. Walk past the corner house. Turn left at the intersection. Walk along the street. Cross the road at the crossing. Walk around the block. Pass the local park. Walk along the park fence. Turn right at the next corner. Walk back along the street. Stop at the pedestrian crossing. Wait for the light. Cross the road. Walk along the footpath towards the house. Turn into the driveway. Walk up the driveway. Unlock the front door with the key. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door. Lock the door. Take off the shoes. Place the shoes on the shoe rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a vegetable-and-legume dinner and portioning extra servings into containers for upcoming shift days.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the carrots. Take out the lentils. Take out the onions. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the cutting board. Pick up the knife. Cut the onions into pieces. Cut the carrots into pieces. Push the pieces to the side of the board. Open the cupboard door. Take out a pot. Close the cupboard door. Place the pot on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pot. Turn on the induction cooker. Add the onions to the pot. Stir with a spatula. Add the carrots. Add the lentils. Pour water into the pot. Put the lid on the pot. Reduce the heat on the induction cooker. Wait for the pot to cook. Turn off the induction cooker. Open the cupboard door. Take out three containers. Close the cupboard door. Place the containers on the counter. Spoon the dinner into the containers. Put the lids on the containers. Open the refrigerator door. Place the containers in the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Spoon the remaining dinner onto a plate. Put the spoon in the sink. Carry the plate to the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and washing the dishes and cooking utensils by hand before loading the dishwasher.
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on the chair at the table. Pick up the fork. Cut the vegetables with the fork. Lift the food to the mouth. Chew. Drink water from the glass. Continue eating. Put the fork down on the plate. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Place the plate in the sink. Open the dishwasher door. Pull out the bottom rack. Pick up the plate from the sink. Rinse the plate under the tap. Place the plate in the rack. Pick up the pot from the induction cooker. Scrub the pot with the sponge. Rinse the pot under the tap. Place the pot in the rack. Pick up the spatula. Wash the spatula with the sponge. Rinse the spatula. Place the spatula in the rack. Pick up the knife and cutting board. Wash both with the sponge. Rinse both under the tap. Place both in the rack. Turn off the tap. Push the bottom rack into the dishwasher. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Wipe the sink edge with the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying at the desk using the computer and monitor, working through social work course readings and taking detailed written notes.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Walk to the desk. Sit on the desk chair. Press the desk lamp switch. Press the computer power button. Wait for the computer to start. Move the mouse. Click the browser icon. Open the university reading list page. Click the first reading. Scroll down the page with the mouse. Read the text on the screen. Open the desk drawer. Take out the notepad. Close the drawer. Pick up a pen. Write the reading title at the top of the page. Write the first main point. Write the second main point. Write the third main point. Scroll down the page. Continue reading. Write a fourth point. Write a short summary line. Put the pen down. Move the mouse. Copy the reference link into the notes document. Click the save icon. Click the second reading. Scroll through the text. Pick up the pen again. Write notes on the second reading. Put the pen down. Press the computer power button. Hold the button to shut down. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Turn off the bedroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry, running a wash load in the washing machine, and hanging clothes to dry.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the laundry basket. Tip the clothes onto the floor. Separate the light-coloured clothes from the dark clothes. Place the light clothes back into the basket. Place the dark clothes in a separate pile. Pick up the dark pile. Open the washing machine door. Load the dark clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the program button. Press the start button. Pick up the light pile. Place the light pile in the laundry basket. Put the laundry basket back in the corner. Wait for the wash cycle. When the cycle finishes, open the washing machine door. Take out the wet clothes. Place the wet clothes in the basket. Pick up the basket. Walk out of the bathroom. Walk to the clothesline. Put the basket on the ground. Pick up the first garment. Shake it out. Hang it on the line with a peg. Pick up the second garment. Shake it out. Hang it with a peg. Continue hanging each garment. Pick up the empty basket. Walk back inside. Walk into the bathroom. Wipe the floor with the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Turn off the bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Desk work: reviewing placement notes and updating a written task list for the coming week.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Walk to the desk. Sit on the desk chair. Press the desk lamp switch. Open the desk drawer. Take out the placement notebook. Close the drawer. Place the notebook on the desk. Open the notebook to the last page. Turn back through the pages. Read the placement notes. Pick up a pen. Circle one entry in the notebook. Turn to a blank page. Write the heading 'Week tasks'. Write the first task. Write the second task. Write the third task. Write the fourth task. Write the fifth task. Number each task on the left side. Draw a checkbox next to each task. Put the pen down. Pick up the phone. Open the calendar app. Check the shift days for the week. Put the phone down on the desk. Pick up the pen again. Copy one date from the phone list onto the notepad page. Put the pen down. Close the notebook. Place the notebook in the desk drawer. Close the drawer. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Turn off the bedroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking the weekly budget against cash receipts and writing reminders for upcoming rent and bill payments.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Walk to the desk. Sit on the desk chair. Press the desk lamp switch. Open the desk drawer. Take out the budget notebook. Take out the folder of receipts. Close the drawer. Place both on the desk. Open the notebook to the current week page. Pick up the first receipt. Read the amount. Write the amount in the notebook. Place the receipt in a pile on the right. Pick up the second receipt. Read the amount. Write the amount in the notebook. Place the receipt on the pile. Continue with the remaining receipts. Pick up the calculator. Press the numbers for each amount. Press the plus key. Press the equals key. Read the total on the display. Write the total at the bottom of the page. Put the calculator down. Write 'rent' on the next line. Write the rent amount. Write 'electricity' on the next line. Write the electricity amount. Pick up the phone. Open the reminders app. Create a reminder for the rent date. Create a reminder for the bill date. Put the phone down. Close the notebook. Place the notebook and receipts in the desk drawer. Close the drawer. Turn off the desk lamp. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Turn off the bedroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making herbal tea and tidying the kitchen surfaces and shared bench space.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the cupboard door. Take out a mug. Close the cupboard door. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Open the cupboard door. Take out the herbal tea box. Close the cupboard door. Open the box. Take out one tea bag. Close the box. Place the tea bag in the mug. Place the box back in the cupboard. Pour the boiled water into the mug. Pick up the cloth from the hook. Wipe the shared bench surface with the cloth. Wipe the stovetop with the cloth. Wipe the sink edge with the cloth. Pick up the toast crumbs with a wet hand. Rinse the hand under the tap. Wipe the hand with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth out. Hang the cloth on the hook. Pick up the mug. Carry the mug out of the kitchen. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing the evening hygiene routine and brushing teeth before bed.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Place the mug on the basin edge. Turn on the tap. Wet the hands under the water. Pick up the soap. Lather the hands. Rinse the hands. Turn off the tap. Pick up the toothbrush from the holder. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Put the toothpaste tube down. Brush the teeth. Spit into the basin. Rinse the mouth with water from the cup. Turn on the tap. Rinse the toothbrush under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the toothbrush back in the holder. Pick up the floss. Pull a length of floss from the container. Break the floss off. Floss between the teeth. Drop the used floss into the bin. Wipe the mouth with the towel. Hang the towel on the hook. Pick up the mug. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down quietly, setting the alarm and reminders for the next shift, and turning off the light to sleep.
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 1. Turn on the bedroom light. Place the mug on the desk. Sit on the desk chair. Press the desk lamp switch. Pick up the phone. Press the phone button. Unlock the phone. Open the clock app. Tap the alarm time field. Set the alarm to the shift wake-up time. Tap save. Open the reminders app. Add a reminder for the shift start time. Add a reminder for the train departure time. Put the phone on the bedside table. Stand up. Push the chair under the desk. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Sit on the bed. Take off the slippers. Place the slippers beside the bed. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Adjust the pillow under the head. Turn on the bedside lamp. Turn off the bedside lamp. Turn off the bedroom light. Press the fan button to turn on the fan. Close the eyes. Sleep.
